content: Refresh-token race condition: when N concurrent requests all 401 on an expired access token, a naive interceptor calls the refresh endpoint N times; with rotating refresh tokens each subsequent refresh call invalidates the previous one, so N-1 requests end up permanently logged out. Fix: a single in-flight refresh promise (mutex/queue) that all failed requests await, then retry once with the new token; do not let each request trigger its own refresh call.
